langmod.items.title: Items
langmod.items.legend: Click an item to turn it on or off. Green: you say its name when you pick it up. Red: picked up normally.
langmod.language.title: Choose a language to learn
langmod.language.hint: Each language keeps its own progress. Switching gives back the item you are being asked about.
langmod.config.title: LangMod Settings
langmod.config.language.tooltip: The language you are learning. Each keeps its own progress. Also: Practice Language in the game menu and /langmod language.
langmod.config.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off, picking things up works like vanilla and held items are given back.
langmod.config.showEnglish.tooltip: Show the English name under the name you are learning in the challenge popup.
langmod.config.maxAttempts.tooltip: Wrong answers allowed before the item disappears. Silence and recognition errors never count.
langmod.config.timerSeconds.tooltip: Time to say the word. The countdown pauses while you speak and while Whisper is checking.
langmod.config.matchMode.strict.tooltip: Every syllable or word must match, and in Mandarin its tone (neutral tones are always accepted).
langmod.config.matchMode.toneless.toolti: Syllables must match, tones are ignored. Only differs from Strict in Mandarin.
langmod.config.matchMode.lenient.tooltip: Like strict, but names of 4 or more syllables, characters or words may have one of them wrong.
langmod.config.maxNameLength.tooltip: For the language you are learning: names longer than this (characters in Mandarin and Japanese, words otherwise) count as long, and are handled as set in "Long names".
langmod.config.longNameMode.tooltip: For the language you are learning. Lenient: one wrong syllable or word is allowed. Skip: long names are never challenged.
langmod.config.promptBiasing.tooltip: For the language you are learning: give Whisper the expected word as a hint. Easier to pass, but it may also "hear" the word when you said something close to it. On by default except in Mandarin: in the other languages Whisper missed many correct answers without it.
langmod.config.modelSize.tooltip: Bigger models recognise speech better but are slower. Small is a good default. File: %s. %s
langmod.config.modelSize.missing: Not downloaded yet: get it from %2$s and put it in %1$s
langmod.config.speechEngine.tooltip: Built-in runs whisper.cpp inside the game on the CPU. whisper-server runs a separate whisper.cpp program (needed for the GPU, see README).
langmod.config.useGpu.tooltip: Only used by the whisper-server engine with a GPU build of whisper.cpp. The built-in engine always uses the CPU.
langmod.config.audioContext.tooltip: How much audio Whisper processes per answer. Whisper normally always processes 30 seconds, even for a one-second word. 10 s is about 4x faster and was as accurate in tests; "Clip only" is fastest but much less accurate.
langmod.config.whisperThreads.tooltip: Threads Whisper may use. Auto uses half of your cores (at most 8) so Minecraft keeps running smoothly.
langmod.config.micDevice.tooltip: Which microphone to record from. Run /langmod test to try it.
langmod.config.vadThresholdDb.tooltip: How much louder than the background noise you must be to count as speaking. Lower it if you are not picked up, raise it if noise starts recordings.
langmod.config.hanziScale.tooltip: Size of the name in the challenge popup (long names are shrunk to fit the screen).
langmod.config.debugOverlay.tooltip: Show what Whisper heard, its pinyin or romanization, the match result and timings (also F9 or /langmod debug).
